question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**era**" means a significant period marked by distinctive character, events, etc. (युग)
 
• In the context of the passage, **"heralds the dawn of a new era" **suggests the beginning of a transformative period due to literacy.
 
• The other options: "**year**," "**day**," "**season**," and "**month**" do not convey the same sense of a significant, long-term change.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *It heralds the dawn of a new era__.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Day (दिन)**: means a period of 24 hours. It is too short to signify a transformative period.
 
• **Season (मौसम)**: means a division of the year marked by specific weather. It is not used to signify major historical or transformative periods.
 
• **Month (महीना)**: means a period of roughly 30 days. It does not imply a significant era or period of change.
